title: trench.parapet_raised_requires_m9c
description: M9B forward-compat warning. When `parapet_raised` (which embeds the M9C-owned `breastwork` sandbag module) is dug in a build where M9C is absent (cf-trench compiled with `--no-default-features`, i.e. `m9c` feature off), validation fails and emits this event with `requires_m9c=true` per VAL-M9B-PARAPET-FWDCOMPAT-001.
